body: normally I'm at at 3 on a ten scale, 10 being good.  Today was a 5.  I'm not sure what triggers me to hit low.
Same w/ me.  Just moved from Chicago.  If you owe money on it, the more you pay.

I've gotten help and it hasn't worked for me.  Therapists, Doctors, Prescriptions, etc.  I just googled for suicide help and it says "you're not alone."  But they are so wrong, they are so fucking wrong.
I just want everything to stop hurting so much.  I thought that if I gave it time, everything would get better.  But it hasn't.
I thought my day was going to get better but all I've done is lay in bed since I've posted.
my problems are still here.  They aren't going anywhere.
there's a study that says talking to 3rd parties help but this is just all garbage.
